description: Hybrid post-quantum cryptography for TypeScript and JavaScript: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, X-Wing, encrypted envelopes, JWTs, key migration. Rust compiled to WebAssembly, byte-compatible with quantum-safe-py.
rules: This library is pre-1.0 and has not been independently audited; do not describe it as audited, FIPS-validated or constant-time.
Verification takes the expected context explicitly (expectedContext); never read the context from the message being verified.
Use pure ML-KEM-1024 and ML-DSA-87 for CNSA 2.0 profiles; X25519 hybrids are reported 'partial'.
